This may be related to #6657 but I'm not sure.

## Reporting a bug

- [X] I have tried using the latest released version of Numba 0.57.1 (with a few debian patches) output of numba -s after the stack trace
- [X] I have included a self contained code sample to reproduce the problem.
  i.e. it's possible to run as 'python bug.py'.

While running the full test suite on arm64 I had encountered various segfaults.

Once I got a system with gdb available the first one encounted by numba.runtests is test_dictobject.py test_007_collision_check  

Here's the start of a gdb stack trace generated by
